prompt: Can you review this smart contract for bugs? It's a land certificate NFT system I'm building.

assertions.text: Identifies the dead admin-fallback bug (onlyRole(ISSUER_ROLE) blocking the documented '(or admin)' fallback) in at least one of registerPlots/issue/reissue/revoke
Identifies the reassignBeneficiary + reissue() manufactured-beneficiary combo as a critical unilateral theft path an issuer can execute against their own issued certificates
States a concrete exploit call sequence (specific function calls in order, not just 'this could allow theft')
Assigns differentiated severity -- treats the manufactured-beneficiary bug as materially more severe than the dead-admin-fallback bug, rather than flat-listing all findings at the same weight
Delivers corrected code (not prose-only description) if the user's framing ('I'm building') suggests they'd want a fix
